sentences.en: Last summer, I took a trip to a town by the sea.
sentences.zh: 去年夏天，我去海边的一个小镇旅行了。

sentences.en: I went there by train with my sister.
sentences.zh: 我和我姐妹坐火车去的。

sentences.en: The train was very long and the seats were soft.
sentences.zh: 火车很长，座位很软。

sentences.en: We went through a valley and across a river.
sentences.zh: 我们穿过了一个山谷和一条河流。

sentences.en: The town had a beautiful beach with white sand.
sentences.zh: 小镇有一个美丽的白色沙滩。

sentences.en: We walked on the sand and looked at the sea.
sentences.zh: 我们在沙滩上散步，看着大海。

sentences.en: The water was warm.
sentences.zh: 水很温暖。

sentences.en: I went for a swim.
sentences.zh: 我去游了泳。

sentences.en: In the evening, we had fish for dinner.
sentences.zh: 晚上，我们吃了鱼当晚餐。

sentences.en: The food was the best part of the day.
sentences.zh: 食物是那天最棒的部分。

sentences.en: I sent a letter to my mother from the town.
sentences.zh: 我从镇上给妈妈寄了一封信。

sentences.en: The trip was better than I had thought.
sentences.zh: 这次旅行比我想象的更好。

sentences.en: I had a great time and I want to go again.
sentences.zh: 我玩得很开心，我想再去一次。

sentences.en: The journey from my town to the sea was long.
sentences.zh: 从我的小镇到海边的路程很长。

sentences.en: The motion of the train made me tired.
sentences.zh: 火车的晃动让我很累。

sentences.en: I made an observation about the old buildings.
sentences.zh: 我观察到了那些古老的建筑。

sentences.en: The island was small and quiet.
sentences.zh: 那个岛又小又安静。

sentences.en: The range of mountains we saw was beautiful.
sentences.zh: 我们看到的那片山脉很美丽。

sentences.en: The level of water in the sea was higher.
sentences.zh: 海平面更高了。

sentences.en: The carriage on the train was full of people.
sentences.zh: 火车车厢里挤满了人。

sentences.en: I saw an angle on the roof of the old building.
sentences.zh: 我看到老建筑屋顶上的一个角。

sentences.en: The harbor was full of boats.
sentences.zh: 海港里停满了船。

sentences.en: The view from the top was a beautiful scene.
sentences.zh: 从顶上看去的景色很美。

sentences.en: There was a feeling of harmony in the small town.
sentences.zh: 小镇里有一种和谐的感觉。

sentences.en: My guide showed us the best places.
sentences.zh: 我们的向导给我们看了最好的地方。

sentences.en: A vessel like a ship was at the harbor.
sentences.zh: 一艘像船一样的船只在港口。

sentences.en: A wave came from the sea.
sentences.zh: 一个浪从海上袭来。
